scope: Audit fixes on v88.1.2 (extensive audit, 11 September 2026). F01: shared registers require the office or an approved, active worker; an applicant who has only registered cannot read or write them (own personal forms unaffected). F02: schedule checks (leave, time windows, weekdays) run before the service-area check, so an out-of-area confirmation only ever waives the area — on creation, acceptance, moves, series edits, office assignment and cover. F03/F04: policy publishing accepts Word and PDF files (12 MB request cap) and register saves up to 1.5 MB; the 413 message names the real limit. F05: cover review honours the worker's explicit out-of-area confirmation. F06: sleepover active hours must be a finite number between 0 and the shift length; invalid values are refused and nothing is completed or invoiced. F08: moved occurrences and edited series record the out-of-area confirmation on the booking. F07/F13: release identity files regenerated together; the demo database and its sidecars removed from the repository. Tests added for F01, F02, F04 and F06. No schema change. v88.1.4: F09 — Google drive times are labelled a planning estimate with when they were checked, traffic-aware figures cached six hours; F10 — the homepage stories are labelled illustrative and no longer say claiming is automatic; F11 — the graphics tests now measure the shipped design (logo, palette, documents, emails, honesty labels, the animated site) and run in npm test, baselines refreshed; F12 — the boot audit snapshot runs after start-up completes.
unchanged_assets: Existing scenes, photographs, artwork, vendor assets and self-hosted font files stay in the base repository.
